sentences.text:
For Petitioner : Mr.M.R.Sreenivasan
 For Respondents : M/s.K.Malathi
 Additional Government Pleader
 Order

This writ petition is filed seeking issuance of writ of mandamus directing the respondents to consider the petitioner's representation, dated 08.04.2025 and further to direct the respondents to reconsider and refix the fair compensation on the basis of the today's market price.
2.It is the case of the petitioner that he is the owner of the property situated in Survey No.176/8A with an extent of 24.650 cents, Nalloor Village, Vilavancode Taluk, Kanyakumari District.
According to the petitioner, a portion of this property has been taken over by the first respondent for the purpose of extension of Double Line Railway Track from Thiruvananthapuram to Kanyakumari.

Apprehending that the first _________ https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on:
03/06/2025 07:41:16 pm ) respondent would fix the compensation based on the old guideline value,
the petitioner submitted a representation before the respondents seeking fixation of compensation based on the present market value.
The said representation has not been considered.
Hence, the petitioner has come before this Court.

3.M/s.K.Malathi, learned Additional Government Pleader, who takes notice for the respondents would submit that the first respondent, who is the competent authority has not determined the compensation payable to the petitioner and it is open to the petitioner to make his submission before the first respondent.
4.Since the first respondent has not fixed the compensation for the land acquired from the petitioner, this Court is not inclined to issue any direction to the first respondent at this stage.

The first respondent is expected to fix the compensation payable to the land owners in the light of the provision of the Right To Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act.
